definitions.explanation: Describes an attitude or behavior that pressures others through authority or force, leaving no room for disagreement.

examples.japanese: {高圧的|こうあつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高圧的|こうあつてき}な⟦{物言|ものい}い→物言い：13487_monoii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられない→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。
examples.english: I can't stand my boss's domineering way of speaking.

examples.japanese: {高圧的|こうあつてき}な⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: A high-handed negotiating style invites resistance from the other party.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧ (high pressure) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (like, -ish). Literally "high-pressure-like." Always carries a negative connotation — describes bullying, coercive, or domineering behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高圧的|こうあつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: overbearing attitude
- {高圧的|こうあつてき}な⟦{物言|ものい}い→物言い：13487_monoii⟧: domineering way of speaking
- {高圧的|こうあつてき}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: high-handed treatment
- {高圧的|こうあつてき}に⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to come on strong, to take a coercive stance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{威圧的|いあつてき}→威圧的：06373_iatsuteki⟧な: intimidating (emphasizes making others feel threatened)
- ⟦{横柄|おうへい}→横柄：07317_ouhei⟧な: arrogant, insolent (rude superiority)
- ⟦{強引|ごういん}→強引：04156_gouin⟧な: forceful, pushy (forcing one's way regardless of others)
